Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of agreed POC scope:
- Use case A: Contextual support (chat + tool calling) for 50 internal agents
- Use case B: Embeddings for knowledge search (re-ranking top 10 results)

Success criteria (initial):
- Chat: average response latency < 600ms P50 for < 1k tokens, and > 85% agent satisfaction (survey)
- Embeddings: 8-10% uplift in click-through on top result vs baseline test set

Timeline and ownership:
- Kickoff: Week of June 24 (we can do an intro tech call Mon 6/24)
- POC length: 4 weeks (baseline -> run -> evaluate)
- Redwood: Marissa (PM, GTM) + Dev Patel (technical lead) + Neha Kapoor (CS)
- Acme: John (product), Priya (data)

Reqs from Acme: sample dataset for embeddings (anonymized), credentials for non-prod environment, and a primary procurement contact for SOW.

Attachments: POC_Success_Criteria_ACME_v1.docx (high-level criteria + evaluation plan)

Next steps:
1) Please review the success criteria doc and reply with any additions/changes by EOD Wed 6/24.
2) Confirm kickoff slot Mon 6/24 or suggest alternatives.
3) Share procurement contact so we can route SOW.

Thanks — excited to get this started.

—

Marissa — quick feasibility note after a rapid sync with infra & models team:

- Tech feasibility: Adding reranking (Use Case C) is feasible within our runtime. We can surface embeddings and run a lightweight learned reranker in the POC environment.
- Constraints: We'll need the following from Acme: a labeled evaluation set for reranking (or a proxy CTR log), and consistent query volume estimates so we can size the serving pool.
- Timeline impact: +2 weeks on the evaluation window is the right call. Proposed new timeline: 6/24 kickoff -> 6/24-7/21 active run (4 weeks run + 2 weeks extra evaluation) -> final analysis by 7/28.
- Resource ask: +0.25 FTE (engineering on-call) and increase Dedicated GPU quota by one slot for peak tests. Neha, can CS cover monitoring and annotation coordination?

I've attached an updated SOW (SOW_ACME_v2.pdf) that reflects the new scope and the evaluation metrics we should track (NDCG, CTR lift, latency P50/P95 per route).

Proposed revised success criteria (additions):
- Reranking: NDCG@10 uplift >= 6% vs baseline OR CTR uplift >= 5% on live test; P95 latency for reranker < 1200ms.
- Maintain existing chat/embedding targets (see attached doc).

I'll prepare a short runbook for the test harness and data ingestion steps once we get confirmation from Acme.

—
